visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic buyer-intent pages: live MLS search as the next step, a specific process walkthrough, buyer strategy sub-pages, and a listing-alerts ask. Zero invented stats.
note: E-HOMES-SEARCH 2026-08-13. Migrated /buy onto the v3 barrel. Chrome: layout mounts V3Chrome (sticky, in flow). This page does not remount it. V3Breadcrumb tone=on-media overlays the Stage (ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay). V3Footer outside <main>. Page contract carried unchanged: pageMetadata title/description/path, revalidate 300, getSurfaceImage hero, BreadcrumbList + WebPage + FAQPage JSON-LD, KbSectionTracker pageType=buy, listing-alert capture via submitSearchAlertSignup (email + propertyType A + company honeypot), exits to /homes-for-sale, /buy/[intent], /open-houses, /price-drops, /contact. Dual objectives unchanged. KB-era deletions: SmoothScrollProvider, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css, RegionalSfrAlertsBand / KbCommunityAlerts markup, six hero chips (Search homes stays as the Stage primary; the rest moved to the closing Quiet), the no-hand-off pitch. MetadataBlock and KbSectionTracker stay on non-v3 registers (JSON-LD + analytics, not visual language). /buy/[intent] still renders LeadLandingPage and is out of this lease.

openDefects._: Drafted 2026-08-27 against this page's own competitiveTarget.
items: NO LIVE INVENTORY ANYWHERE ON THE PAGE. The competitive target's first clause is 'live MLS search as the next step'. The page renders no listing tiles, no active count, and no market figure -- verified: it calls none of getListingTiles, leftoverHudKpis, getMarketPulse. A buyer-intent page with no houses on it loses to Zillow on the only thing Zillow is good at.
The opening is a Stage with no figure, so the first screen states nothing a buyer can act on.
